congress_health.description: How fresh and complete is the congressional data? Coverage, freshness, source mix, and the standing caveats.

congress_latest_filings.description: What filings are new since a timestamp (ISO-8601, any offset)? Filing-level awareness for polling, including paper filings pending OCR and amendment-flagged filings.

congress_member_activity.description: Show a member's trading history and habits (top tickers, buy/sell mix, median days-to-file, late-filing count). Use congress_member_lookup to get the bioguide_id.

congress_member_flows.description: A member's net disclosed FLOW by ticker (purchases vs sales). These are flow estimates from disclosed transactions, NOT holdings — true holdings require annual FD reports (not yet ingested).

congress_member_lookup.description: Who is this member? Resolve a name (or fragment) to canonical members with bioguide IDs for use in other tools.

congress_recent_trades.description: What has Congress traded recently? Filter by chamber, party, state, side, ticker, member, or minimum disclosed amount.

congress_ticker_activity.description: Who in Congress is trading a ticker (mode='detail'), the most-traded tickers (mode='top'), or the biggest disclosed trades (mode='biggest')? Amounts are statutory ranges; 'biggest' ranks by the range's upper bound.

inst_biggest_moves.description: The largest cross-filer 13F position changes in a quarter. side ∈ {new, add, trim, exit, unclassified}, ranked by the absolute dollar change, truncated at limit. 'unclassified' is a real change whose direction could not be determined because a value was undisclosed on one side; those rows appear under no other side. 'new'/'exit' mean a position was present or absent between two filings — not bought or sold. Positions with no usable identity key are excluded from the ranking entirely. Reads the published aggregate; period is a quarter-end date like 2026-03-31 (omit for the latest).

inst_filer_holdings.description: A 13F filer's holdings. mode='snapshot': the published aggregate profile (position count, total value, concentration) plus, when this filer+period is in the published universe, the full published position list. mode='qoq': the filer's quarter-over-quarter position changes. mode='detail': the position list — served from the published snapshot when the build published it (no network), and fetched LIVE from SEC EDGAR only for a period newer than the build or a filer/period outside the published universe; on the live path check composition_complete, because an unparseable filing or an unread history shard can make it partial. Every response carries `federated_boundary` saying which path answered it and why. Use inst_filer_lookup to get the CIK; period is a quarter-end date like 2026-03-31; limit bounds one page of the published position list, and `cursor` (from a previous response's `next_cursor`) continues it — a filer with more positions than `limit` is paged, never truncated beyond reach.

inst_filer_lookup.description: Who is this 13F filer? Resolve an institutional manager name fragment or a CIK to canonical filers (with CIKs) from the published aggregate, for use in the other inst tools.

inst_health.description: How fresh and complete is the institutional (13F) data? Module presence, snapshot build, freshness (latest report period + latest filed date), filer/position counts, issuer-keying mix, and the standing caveats.

inst_ticker_holders.description: Who are the biggest institutional (13F) holders of a stock? Resolves the ticker to its issuer CIK via SEC's company_tickers.json (a PRESENT-DAY mapping, explicitly labeled), then ranks 13F filers by the value they reported holding of that issuer at a quarter-end. The published aggregate keeps only a top-N slice of holders per issuer per quarter (see published_topn/effective_cut in the response), so this list is always TRUNCATED. period is a quarter-end date like 2026-03-31; omit it for the latest.

populus_health.description: Platform-level health: which data modules are loaded, the snapshot build, and freshness.
